description: Header file defining interfaces, constants, and data structures for TunerStudio I/O communication in firmware, including command definitions, buffer sizes, and function prototypes.

classes.name: ts_channel_s
classes.description: Structure representing a TunerStudio communication channel, including buffers and channel pointer.

classes.name: uart_dma_s
classes.description: Structure for managing asynchronous DMA transfer buffers and queues.

methods.name: startTsPort
methods.description: Initializes and starts the TunerStudio port communication on the given channel.

methods.name: stopTsPort
methods.description: Stops the TunerStudio port communication on the given channel.

methods.name: sr5WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the TunerStudio channel.

methods.name: sr5WriteCrcPacket
methods.description: Sends a CRC-protected packet with a response code.

methods.name: sr5SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response over the TunerStudio channel in specified format.

methods.name: sr5ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the TunerStudio channel.

methods.name: sr5ReadDataTimeout
methods.description: Reads data with a timeout from the TunerStudio channel.

methods.name: sr5IsReady
methods.description: Checks if the TunerStudio channel is ready for communication.
